description_en: Queries the task list of a specified team under a specified instance. The task metadata is sourced from the OSS bucket bound to the instance
description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下某个团队的任务列表，任务元数据来源于实例绑定的 OSS 存储桶
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-team-tasks --instance-id agentteams-test-001 --team my-team --max-results 10 --next-token 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTeamTasks

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数，取值 1-100，默认 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token, which is the offset integer string returned from the previous page
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌，为上一页返回的偏移量整数字符串
parameters.name: next_token
